name: Understanding the Timeline for Your Kitchen Modernization Project

step.name: Step 1: Planning & Design (Typically 4-12 weeks) — This phase is all about defining your goals, refining the layout, and making material selections. We develop CAD-supported layouts that align with your vision for enhancing functionality, beauty, and value. This timeline can stretch if custom cabinetry or very specific, hard-to-source finishes are desired, as these items often have longer lead times that need to be factored in upfront. We ensure all design elements are harmonized before moving forward.

step.name: Step 2: Permit Coordination & Approvals (Typically 2-8 weeks, can vary by jurisdiction) — Before any significant work begins, necessary permits must be obtained. This step involves submitting detailed plans to local authorities in the Dallas–Fort Worth metroplex. The exact duration depends on the complexity of your project (e.g., if walls are moving, or if plumbing/electrical layouts are significantly changing) and the current workload of the local permitting office. Our team handles this critical coordination as part of our single point of coordination service.

step.name: Step 3: Material Ordering & Delivery (Varies, often overlapping with design and permitting) — Once designs are finalized and permits are underway, we place orders for your chosen materials. Custom cabinetry, appliances, countertops, and certain specialty tiles can have lead times ranging from a few weeks to several months. Effective management of this step is crucial to avoid construction delays, underscoring our focus on reliability.

step.name: Step 4: Demolition & Rough-In Construction (Typically 2-4 weeks) — With permits in hand and materials arriving, demolition can commence. This is followed by the installation or relocation of plumbing, electrical, and HVAC systems. Inspections will occur at various points during this 'rough-in' phase to ensure everything meets code before walls are closed up. This is where the physical transformation truly begins.

step.name: Step 5: Finish Installation & Detailing (Typically 4-8 weeks) — This is the exciting part! Flooring, custom cabinetry, countertops, backsplashes, and light fixtures are installed. This phase requires meticulous craftsmanship and attention to detail to ensure every element contributes to the cohesive, high-quality finish you expect. Our team's dedication to craftsmanship shines through here, ensuring a lasting impression.

step.name: Step 6: Final Walkthrough & Punch List (Typically 1-2 weeks) — As the project nears completion, we conduct a thorough walkthrough with you. Any minor adjustments or touch-ups are noted on a 'punch list' and promptly addressed to ensure every detail meets your satisfaction. This final step ensures your new kitchen is absolutely perfect, marking the successful completion of our managed process.
